propositions: Infrastructure exceptions (LLMUnavailableError) at gate sites must emit an additive ERROR sidecar record with gate_error_v1 schema, cause, and evidence_ref without altering the existing per-gate outcome contract.
Plan-review and code-review gates catch LLMUnavailableError, write the ERROR record, and return degraded INDETERMINATE verdict (soft-degrade preserved).
Completion gate wraps preflight to emit the ERROR record then re-raises LLMUnavailableError (fail-closed contract preserved).
gate_error_v1 records bypass reconcile_verdict so ERROR verdict survives unconverted, while existing verdict readers remain schema-guarded and skip ERROR records.
Domain-level BLOCK/FAIL exceptions do not emit ERROR records; only infrastructure exceptions trigger the error path.
Existing readers (latest_review_result, latest_fail_verdict) ignore gate_error_v1 via schema guard, preventing ERROR pollution of verdict reads.
